sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*138\.1[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24188894' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%138.1%' LIMIT 5
